from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    # The uniform field is the background; recolor it one step down and
    # erase every non-background mark to zero.
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background - 1 if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
